本仪表盘由 GitHub Actions 定时工作流自动生成。它定期抓取 Hyp: Ana ƙirƙirar wannan babban allo kai tsaye ta hanyar workflow na GitHub Actions mai tsari. Yana ɗaukar bayanan jama'a na Hypixel SkyBlock API lokaci-lokaci, kuma yana kwatanta kowace amsa da hoton da ya gabata; ana rubuta filayen da aka ƙara, goge ko canza a cikin rikodin canje-canje na sama cikin salon bitar lamba (diff). «Sigar yanzu» a saman shafin yana zuwa daga filin version na endpoints biyu na albarkatu, collections da skills: saboda Hypixel yana sabuntawa cikin rukuni, endpoints biyun ba lallai ba ne su sauya lokaci ɗaya, don haka sabuwar siga ana tabbatar da ita ne kawai idan dukansu sun yi daidai. Idan ba su yi daidai ba, ana riƙe sigar da ta gabata da ta tsaya tsayin daka kuma ana nuna «Ana daidaitawa», wanda ke hana lambar siga yin tsalle-tsalle. Ana rubuta sauyin siga daban a cikin panel ɗin «Tarihin siga», ba a haɗa su da rikodin canje-canjen abun ciki na endpoint ba; wannan panel ɗin kuma yana riƙe kwanaki 30 na ƙarshe kawai, har zuwa rikodi 20. An tace canje-canjen farashin Bazaar — ana bin diddigin ƙari da gogewar kayayyaki na tsari kawai. Endpoint ɗin resource pack kowane lokaci yana ɗaukar sigar da ke da mafi girman lambar packFormat (wannan lambar tana canzawa yayin da MC ke sabuntawa); idan hash na hukuma ya canza, yana ɗaukar zip ɗin ya buɗe shi, sannan yana kwatanta fayilolin da aka ƙara, goge ko canza a cikin resource pack ɗin ta hanyar hash na abun cikin fayil. Fayilolin rubutu da aka canza suna nuna sashen da ya canza kawai da ja da kore, yayin da fayilolin da aka ƙara a kore kawai ake nuna su. Endpoint ɗin Bingo yana rubuta lokacin wallafawa da lokutan farawa da ƙarewa na manufofin kowane zango, kuma yana jera kowane manufa a cikin grid 5×5 (daga hagu zuwa dama, daga sama zuwa ƙasa; danna kwaya don ganin cikakken rubutu); ƙidayar lokaci tana ba da epoch milliseconds na start / end ga browser, wanda ke ƙidaya kowace daƙiƙa, don haka jinkirin ɗauka na Actions ba ya shafar sa. Ana nuna lambobin launi na Minecraft (§) a cikin rubutun manufa da launukan hukuma, kuma ci gaban server gaba ɗaya don nunawa ne kawai kuma ba ya shiga kwatancen canje-canje. Ana sake ɗaukar endpoint ɗin Firesales a kowane gudu (hukumomi na iya daidaita lokaci, yawa ko farashi kafin a fara sayarwa), kowane sayarwa yana da katinsa da ke nuna farashi da yawa, kuma maɓallin «Nuna ƙarin bayanai» yana buɗe dukan zanguna da JSON na asali. Idan wani endpoint ko ɗaukar resource pack ya ci tura, gudun ba ya taɓa kowane bayanai a cikin ma'ajiya.
